quote.title: Quote of the Day
quote.cipher: UJVUZH EXI AW AKD HKWEA VUZ; UIN AKD HKWEA VUZ QH AKD IUAXEUJ: UGGWENQIBJZ HUZ UIN NW DPDEZAKQIB QI GWICWETQAZ VQAK AKD HWXINDHA EDUHWI.
quote.text: Always run to the short way; and the short way is the natural: accordingly say and do everything in conformity with the soundest reason.

verse.title: Verse of the Day
verse.cipher: GNQ VKC BNQJ NG HNJ DZ UODEP, MAJ INBCQGOS, MAJ ZKMQICQ VKMA MAF VBNCJHCJ ZBNQJ, IDCQEDAH CLCA VN VKC JDLDJDAH MZOAJCQ NG ZNOS MAJ ZIDQDV, MAJ NG VKC WNDAVZ MAJ TMQQNB, MAJ DZ M JDZECQACQ NG VKC VKNOHKVZ MAJ DAVCAVZ NG VKC KCMQV.
verse.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
